description: A Government of Madhya Pradesh higher-education college campus identified as Shaskiya Mahavidyalaya, Mohan Badodiya, in Shajapur district.

supports: NIRF 2025 lists Govt. College, Mohan Badodia, Shajapur, Madhya Pradesh.
The Madhya Pradesh Higher Education college directory lists the campus as शा.कॉलेज मोहन बडोदिया.
The official campus page identifies Shaskiya Mahavidyalaya, Mohan Badodiya, Shajapur, under Madhya Pradesh Higher Education.
The official At A Glance page repeats the institution and district identity.
The official Academics menu lists the Regular Course family स्‍नातक - कला संकाय and the campus departments.
The official Programmes Offered page contains PG, UG, and Diploma sections but no populated course rows.
The official regular-course destination is labelled by the site as स्‍नातक - कला संकाय but is currently under construction.
The official Distance Education Programme page has empty PG, UG, and Diploma tables.
The official Prospectus page is under construction and provides no programme details.
